differences.what: A's left woofer grille is lit evenly and shows a fine fabric/brushed texture with a clean rim; in B a hard window-mullion shadow cuts the grille in half and the disc reads as flat painted plastic
A's wall plaster texture is crisp and the light is warm and even; B's wall is softer and grainy in the shaded areas, with smeared, denoised-looking texture
In A the turntable and books sit in light, so the clear platter, gold spindle and book spines read; in B the turntable sits in shade and turns into a murky green-grey blur against a grey wall
A has a hard vertical green-and-yellow caustic streak running down the middle credenza door that looks like a render artifact; B's credenza is clean
B's sunlit window patches on the wall make a stronger, more editorial light composition that frames the left speaker; A's light is a flat wash with one diagonal shadow edge
Both have a green caustic spill on the wall and floor behind the right speaker; it is milder in A
